title: Accept 3000016: CoNP-completeness of binary directed chip-firing reachability
body:
## Accepted result and published preprint **CoNP-completeness of binary directed chip-firing reachability**, Alec Kriebel. Published paper and verification package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23431676 (https://zenodo.org/records/23431676).

Ordinary legal chip-firing reachability is coNP-complete under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions for finite loopless strongly connected directed multigraphs, with binary adjacency entries, nonnegative binary initial and target configurations, and varying vertex count. An explicit NONHALTING-to-REACHABLE map uses a finite-state cutoff, exact pre-gate simulation, a gate cleanup budget, and a marker that forces the first gate in every target-reaching word. The complete proof includes loop relays, signed-source threshold normalization, singleton and malformed-input cases, arbitrary target-reaching firing counts, binary output bounds, and the credited reduced-count coNP certificate. It answers the historical general-digraph hardness question in this precise model; no simple-graph, unary, bounded-degree, bounded-chip-count or signed-membership extension is asserted.

Farrell-Levine supplies source hardness and the total-Laplacian interface; Björner-Lovász supplies period deletion and reduced counts; Hujter-Kiss-Tóthmérész supplies coNP membership and the recurrent-target theorem; Tóthmérész supplies the earlier recurrence-to-reachability conversion and hierarchy barrier; Kiss-Tóthmérész 2015, Section 4, supplies prior large-reserve finite-horizon simulation. Neither scaling nor reserve simulation in general is claimed as new. Exact-result, gadget and method priority, independent discovery and present-day worldwide openness remain UNKNOWN after the bounded audit. Unavailable and uninspected original sources remain UNKNOWN.

The upload includes the paper and a portable standard-library verification kit with complete proof source, new exact finite controls and deliberate faults, scoped source metadata, individual custody decisions and deterministic integrity tools. These supplement the written proof; they do not replay the original edition's omitted historical programs or certify a universal theorem by finite tests. AI tools were used extensively in solving, checking, programming, source comparison and writing. This work is unrefereed; internal AI reviews are not external human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification.

## Accepted scope and review Polynomial-time many-one NONHALTING≤m REACHABLE establishes coNP-hardness, and prior coNP membership yields coNP-completeness for loopless strongly connected binary-adjacency directed multigraphs with nonnegative binary initial/target configurations. No directed hardness target gap asserted: nonnegative subclass suffices even though broader source language admits signed configurations. No simple/unary-adjacency hardness claimed. Distinct earlier PH-collapse result credited; source and target complexity encoding must be independently verified. The result is accepted at the exact audited head `ad7b0eeef847da65afe1b691705cfa6e832e8201`. 2 fresh independent complete AI whole-package reviews were completed, with the final review finding zero actionable issues. Subsequent bounded administrative adoption is recorded in the current external ROOT final seal; earlier status/counter/hold fields remain dated history. Prior mathematical results and proof dependencies are credited. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness are unestablished. AI tools were used extensively; this is an unrefereed preprint, without conventional human peer review or formal proof certification. The repository Zenodo uploader verified the exact reviewed metadata and PDF/support bytes. The Google Workspace CLI recorded the DOI/details in the requested tracker with exact read-back. No GitHub release is created. Current audit and publication receipts: `audits/pr1097_3000016`.
Preserved original PR description: dated submission history ## Accepted complete many-one hardness result Legal chip-firing reachability is coNP-complete on finite loopless strongly connected directed multigraphs with binary adjacency entries and nonnegative binary-encoded initial and target configurations. Target: 3000016 / AMR-029-0016. The report gives the explicit polynomial-time many-one reduction NONHALTING <=_m REACHABLE. The full analytic proof preserves the finite-state cutoff, gate/marker construction, exact thresholds, polynomial-bit cleanup budget, nonnegativity, strong connectivity, both reduction directions, reverse proof under arbitrary target-reaching odometers, loop-removal relays and optional signed-input normalization. Aggregate finite checks are supporting metadata only; the proof is independent of every omitted executable. Source NP-completeness is Farrell–Levine, CoEulerian graphs, Corollary 3.2: https://arxiv.org/abs/1502.04690 . Target coNP membership is Hujter–Kiss–Tóthmérész, On the complexity of the chip-firing reachability problem, Theorem 12: https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.03209 . Tóthmérész, Rotor-routing reachability is easy, chip-firing reachability is hard, Theorem 2.3, https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.11970 , is a distinct prior polynomial-hierarchy collapse consequence, not a substitute for the many-one reduction here. ## Distribution and review limits Exactly eight authored proof/audit/acceptance/status and public-source-review or metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/3000016/`. Editorial changes rename the report, reconcile the completed audit, remove private candidate and unavailable-checker references, distinguish historical observations, and bind the distributed proof and audit exactly. Every mathematical argument, example, edge case and scope qualification remains. This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition makes no simple-graph or unary-encoding hardness claim, no first-in-literature or exhaustive-current-openness claim, and no external human peer-review, journal-acceptance, or formal proof-assistant-certification claim. Programs, raw generated outputs, datasets, copied third-party source bodies/PDFs/images and private coordination material are excluded. Edition preparation claims no new scholarly retrieval, source-file rehash, source inspection, literature search, or mathematical test rerun. QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and resets no historical accounting. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
